description: 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원_방송통신기자재 적합성평가 지정시험기관 현황 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원. 방송통신기자재의 적합성평가를 위해 기술기준의 적합성여부를 시험하는 기관으로 전파법 제 58조의 5(시험기관지정 등)에 명시된 근거에 의해 지정기관인 국립전파연구원으로 부터 관련규정에. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원. Its tags are 방송통신기자재, 적합성평가, 기술기준, 적합성여부, 시험업. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
